reviews.text: I bought this product because my friend recommended it to me, and now I can recommend it to you! Great product to clean pores. I have oily/combi skin and use it 1-2 times a week before other masks or treatments.
reviews.zh: 我係朋友推薦之後買嘅，而家我都可以推薦畀你！好好清潔毛孔嘅產品。我係油性／混合皮膚，每星期用一至兩次，喺其他面膜或護理之前使用。

reviews.text: Este producto yo lo estaba usando solo como limpiador y al investigar un poco más a fondo descubrí que se podía utilizar también como una mascarilla! lo utilizo interdiario como para hacer limpiezas más profundas en mi piel y me encanta lo suave cita que la deja 🥰
reviews.zh: 我本來淨係用呢款做潔面，後來深入研究之後先發現原來都可以當面膜用！我隔日用，用嚟深層清潔皮膚，我好鍾意佢用完嗰種柔滑嘅感覺 🥰

reviews.text: promete bastante , si me dejo la piel limpia y tersa pero no noté q mis poros se cerraran además de que cuando te lo hechas deja como un su tono negro ??no lo sé no me agrado tanto y aún tengo poros en mi nariz
reviews.zh: 效果好有潛力，用完皮膚確實乾淨、緊緻，但我冇覺得毛孔收細咗，而且塗上去之後會有一層好似黑色嘅色調??我唔知係咩，我唔係好鍾意，而且我鼻上仲係有毛孔。

reviews.text:
Volví a pedir este producto porque realmente me deja la piel suave y si se ve el efecto de poros más cerrados en su primera lavada.
El producto al inicio te lo pones como mascarilla, con la mano seca, luego esperas unos segundos a 1 min y luego te lo frotas con la mano húmeda para hacer espuma.
reviews.zh:
我再買咗呢款，因為佢真係令皮膚好軟滑，而且第一次洗完就見到毛孔收細咗嘅效果。
一開始要用乾手將產品當面膜咁塗，等幾秒至一分鐘，然後用濕手搓出泡沫。

reviews.text:
A good product, reminiscent of the liquid format of the famous bubble charcoal mask from the same company, but this product feels even more sticky on the skin. Reminds me of nasty glue masks to get rid of blackheads when you apply it. But it does not stick to the skin after, it is easy to wash off, and it pleasantly cleanses the skin. It tightens the skin a little after washing, in my opinion.

Better buy a classic bubble mask.
reviews.zh:
係一款唔錯嘅產品，令我諗起同一品牌嗰款出名嘅液態泡泡竹炭面膜嘅質地，不過呢款塗落皮膚感覺更加黏。塗嗰陣令我諗起啲用嚟除黑頭嘅難用膠水面膜。不過佢唔會黏住皮膚，好容易洗走，而且清潔得幾舒服。我覺得洗完之後皮膚會稍微收緊。

不如買經典嘅泡泡面膜會好啲。

reviews.text: This product leaves nothing on skin and it is perfect for anyone with oily skin. I love the effect of cleanness it leaves after usage. You can “hear” the cleanness while washing your face. After this product I have less acne breakouts and less black dots.
reviews.zh: 呢款產品用完皮膚唔會殘留任何嘢，好啱油性皮膚嘅人。我好鍾意用完嗰種清潔嘅感覺。洗面嗰陣你仲可以「聽到」乾淨嘅聲音。用咗呢款之後，暗瘡同黑點都少咗。

reviews.text:
I have a combination skin und expected this cleansing foam to become my ultimate daily skin care product. Well, it really did justifiy my hope. Pleasant smell, soft texture, cleans perfectly but doesn’t make my skin dry. 
Love it
reviews.zh:
我係混合皮膚，本來期望呢款潔面泡沫可以成為我每日護膚嘅終極產品。呢個期望真係冇落空。味道好聞，質地柔和，清潔效果好好，但係唔會令我皮膚乾燥。
好鍾意

reviews.text: This foam became my favourite during this summer - it is very gentle, but at the same time perfect to clean the pores and to maintain healthy and clean skin. It does not produce any foam , it is more like a black paste. Oh, and it is better to use it in the shower, otherwise the washing sink will become dirty very quicky.
reviews.zh: 呢款泡沫今個夏天成為咗我嘅最愛——好温和，同時又好適合清潔毛孔，保持皮膚健康乾淨。佢其實冇咩泡，比較似一團黑色膏狀物。哦，仲有，最好喺沖涼房用，否則洗手盆好快就會變髒。

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
